The Qoder adapter contains a modified copy of `@magpie-community/opencode-qoder-auth` version 0.2.46, from https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/tree/main/packages/qoder, copyright 2026 magpie-community contributors, distributed under the MIT license in LICENSE. The original, unmodified `index.mjs` from that installed package has SHA-256 `088ea2af1fe807b2859295128e5f08eb0c957dea2effc5d03cce475f945cd456`.

The vendored copy is based on that fixed version and only adds observation of raw Qoder SSE model fields and short-lived, bounded metadata receipts. Future upstream protocol or authentication changes must be synchronized with the upstream package. It retains the CLIProxyAPI attribution and license in LICENSE-CLIProxyAPI, as included by the upstream package. No upstream endorsement is implied.
